fcs_function.name: engine/pressure-altitude-ft
fcs_function.description: pressure altitude from the static pressure, standard atmosphere

fcs_function.name: engine/delta-T-K
fcs_function.description: air temperature above standard at this pressure altitude

fcs_function.name: engine/max-thrust-cycle-lbf
fcs_function.description: maximum thrust: the lowest of fan speed, turbine temperature and the flat rating

fcs_function.name: engine/extra-power-kw-eff
fcs_function.description: power taken off the high-pressure spool above what the installation already holds, kW: the property engine/extra-power-kw, not under 0

fcs_function.name: engine/hpx-thrust-factor
fcs_function.description: the change of the maximum thrust for that power: the cycle model's, per kW, by height and Mach number (fdm/engine.py, HPX_PROBE_KW), linear

fcs_function.name: engine/max-thrust-lbf
fcs_function.description: maximum thrust with that power taken off

fcs_function.name: engine/thrust-cmd-lbf
fcs_function.description: idle to maximum with the throttle; nothing when the engine is stopped

fcs_function.name: engine/fan-share-cmd
fcs_function.description: the fan speed the throttle asks for, as a share of the maximum here: thrust goes with its square

fcs_function.name: engine/fan-rate
fcs_function.description: how fast the fan's speed share changes, per second: towards what the throttle asks with a time constant of 0.38 s (fitted to a Citation X's take-off), but never faster than 0.23 a second above a share of 0.6 (fitted) or 0.115 below it (an estimate) when rising, or 0.23 a second falling (no data), or 1.5 when the engine is failed or stopped

integrator.name: engine/fan-share
integrator.description: the fan's speed as a share of its maximum here: the integral of the rate above (a rate-limited first-order lag, as a fan accelerating under its fuel schedule is)

fcs_function.name: engine/thrust-spooled-lbf
fcs_function.description: the thrust the spooled fan gives: the maximum here times its share squared

switch.name: engine/thrust-lbf
switch.description: the spooled fan's thrust, or the throttle's own when ctl/instant is set (trims)

fcs_function.name: engine/thrust-fraction
fcs_function.description: thrust over the standard-day maximum here

fcs_function.name: engine/fuel-flow-pph
fcs_function.description: fuel flow: the standard-day table, scaled with the square root of the temperature ratio

lag_filter.name: engine/spool
lag_filter.description: the rotors coming up to idle on a start and running down after a shutdown, for the fan's speed (and so the sound): about 20 s to most of the way. An assumed time, and no start sequence is modelled

lag_filter.name: engine/core-spool
lag_filter.description: the high-pressure rotor, which the starter turns and which leads the fan up on a start: most of the way in about 9 s. For the start's sound only; the time is assumed

fcs_function.name: engine/fan-rpm
fcs_function.description: the fan's speed, for the sound and the 3-D model's fan, not used by the flight model. Running: 8,290 rpm times the square root of the thrust's share of the maximum, measured from recordings: 8,290 rpm at take-off (a Global Hawk's take-off pass: the fan's 24th order and its buzz-saw's spacing, less the Doppler shift) and 2,230 to 2,270 rpm at ground idle (two taxiing Global Hawks: the blade passing tone at 891 Hz), which the idle thrust's 7 % gives as 2,190. It comes up and runs down with engine/spool. Stopped in flight it windmills, 9 rpm per knot (assumed)
